tools.name: search
tools.description: Search for files in Google Drive. Set rawQuery=true to pass a raw Google Drive API query supporting operators like modifiedTime, createdTime, mimeType, name contains, etc.

query.description: Search query. When rawQuery=true, this is passed directly to the Google Drive API as the q parameter.

pageToken.description: Token for next page of results

rawQuery.description: If true, pass query directly to Google Drive API without wrapping in fullText contains. Enables date filters, mimeType filters, etc.

tools.name: createTextFile
tools.description: Create a new text or markdown file

tools.name: updateTextFile
tools.description: Update an existing text or markdown file

fileId.description: ID of the file to update

tools.name: createFolder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive

tools.name: listFolder
tools.description: List contents of a folder (defaults to root)

tools.name: listSharedDrives
tools.description: List available Google Shared Drives

tools.name: deleteItem
tools.description: Move a file or folder to trash (can be restored from Google Drive trash)

itemId.description: ID of the item to delete

tools.name: renameItem
tools.description: Rename a file or folder

itemId.description: ID of the item to rename

tools.name: moveItem
tools.description: Move a file or folder

itemId.description: ID of the item to move

tools.name: copyFile
tools.description: Creates a copy of a Google Drive file or document

fileId.description: ID of the file to copy

newName.description: Name for the copied file. If not provided, will use 'Copy of [original name]'

parentFolderId.description: ID or path of the destination folder (defaults to same folder as original)

tools.name: uploadFile
tools.description: Upload a local file (any type: image, audio, video, PDF, etc.) to Google Drive

localPath.description: Absolute path to the local file to upload

name.description: File name in Drive (defaults to local filename)

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder ID or path (e.g., '/Work/Projects'). Creates folders if needed. Defaults to root.

mimeType.description: MIME type (auto-detected from extension if omitted)

convertToGoogleFormat.description: Convert uploaded file to Google Workspace format (e.g., .docx to Google Doc, .xlsx to Google Sheet, .pptx to Google Slides). Defaults to false.

tools.name: downloadFile
tools.description: Download a Google Drive file to a local path. For Google Workspace files (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drawings), exports to the specified format. For regular files, downloads as-is. Streams directly to disk.

localPath.description: Absolute local path to save the file (must start with /). Can be a directory (filename auto-resolved from Drive metadata) or a full file path. Path is normalized before use.

exportMimeType.description: For Google Workspace files: MIME type to export as (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'text/csv'). Auto-detected from file extension if omitted. Ignored for non-Workspace files.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite if file already exists at localPath. When false (default), returns an error instead of replacing the file.

tools.name: listPermissions
tools.description: List sharing permissions for a file

tools.name: addPermission
tools.description: Add a sharing permission to a file

emailMessage.description: Custom message to include in the notification email. Ignored unless sendNotificationEmail is true.

tools.name: updatePermission
tools.description: Update an existing permission role

tools.name: removePermission
tools.description: Remove a permission from a file (by permissionId or emailAddress)

tools.name: shareFile
tools.description: Convenience wrapper to share a file with a user email

emailMessage.description: Custom message to include in the notification email. Ignored unless sendNotificationEmail is true.

tools.name: convertPdfToGoogleDoc
tools.description: Convert an existing PDF in Drive into an editable Google Doc

fileId.description: PDF file ID in Google Drive

tools.name: bulkConvertFolderPdfs
tools.description: Convert all PDFs in a folder into Google Docs and return per-file results

continueOnError.description: Continue conversion when one file fails (default: true)

tools.name: uploadPdfWithSplit
tools.description: Upload PDF and optionally split into chunked parts (metadata split plan for now)

maxPagesPerChunk.description: Target max pages per chunk (advisory metadata)

tools.name: getRevisions
tools.description: List revisions for a file

tools.name: restoreRevision
tools.description: Restore a file to a selected revision (creates a new head revision). Note: workspace files (Docs, Sheets, Slides) are restored via export/import and may lose some formatting.

confirm.description: Safety flag. Must be true to execute restore.

tools.name: authGetStatus
tools.description: Show authentication/token status and scope diagnostics

tools.name: authListScopes
tools.description: List configured/requested scopes and currently granted scopes

tools.name: authTestFileAccess
tools.description: Run auth diagnostics against Drive API/file access

fileId.description: Optional file ID for targeted access check

tools.name: createShortcut
tools.description: Create a shortcut (link) to a file or folder in Google Drive. Useful for referencing the same document from multiple locations without duplicating it.

targetFileId.description: The file or folder ID (not a path) to create a shortcut to

parentFolderId.description: ID or path of the folder where the shortcut will be created

shortcutName.description: Custom name for the shortcut (defaults to original file name)

tools.name: lockFile
tools.description: Lock a file to prevent editing by setting content restrictions. The file remains readable but cannot be modified until unlocked.

fileId.description: ID of the file to lock

reason.description: Reason for locking the file (shown to users who try to edit)

ownerRestricted.description: If true, only the file owner can unlock the file (default: false)

tools.name: unlockFile
tools.description: Unlock a previously locked file by removing content restrictions, restoring full edit access.

fileId.description: ID of the file to unlock

tools.name: createGoogleDoc
tools.description: Create a new Google Doc

tools.name: updateGoogleDoc
tools.description: Update an existing Google Doc (replaces all content). For multi-tab docs, specify tabId to replace a single tab's content atomically; leaves other tabs untouched.

tabId.description: Optional. Tab ID to replace (from listDocumentTabs). If set, delete+insert run in a single atomic batchUpdate scoped to that tab.

tools.name: insertText
tools.description: Insert text at a specific index in a Google Doc (surgical edit, doesn't replace entire doc). For multi-tab docs, specify tabId to target a specific tab.

tabId.description: Optional. Tab ID to insert into (from listDocumentTabs). If omitted, inserts into the first/default tab.

tools.name: deleteRange
tools.description: Delete content between start and end indices in a Google Doc. For multi-tab docs, specify tabId to target a specific tab.

tabId.description: Optional. Tab ID to delete from (from listDocumentTabs). If omitted, deletes from the first/default tab.

tools.name: readGoogleDoc
tools.description: Read content of a Google Doc with format options. Supports multi-tab documents.

tabId.description: Read a specific tab by ID (from listDocumentTabs). If omitted, all tabs are returned.

tools.name: listDocumentTabs
tools.description: List all tabs in a Google Doc with their IDs and hierarchy

includeContent.description: Include content summary (character count) for each tab

tools.name: applyTextStyle
tools.description: Apply text formatting (bold, italic, color, etc.) to a range or found text. Use EITHER startIndex+endIndex OR textToFind for targeting.

textToFind.description: Text to find and format (alternative to indices)

tools.name: applyParagraphStyle
tools.description: Apply paragraph formatting. Use EITHER startIndex+endIndex OR textToFind OR indexWithinParagraph for targeting.

indexWithinParagraph.description: Any index within the target paragraph

tools.name: formatGoogleDocText
tools.description: Apply text formatting (bold, italic, font, color, links) to a range or found text in a Google Doc. Alias for applyTextStyle.

textToFind.description: Text to find and format (alternative to indices)

tools.name: formatGoogleDocParagraph
tools.description: Apply paragraph formatting (alignment, indentation, spacing, heading style) in a Google Doc. Alias for applyParagraphStyle.

indexWithinParagraph.description: Any index within the target paragraph

tools.name: createParagraphBullets
tools.description: Add or remove bullet points / numbered lists on paragraphs in a Google Doc. Target paragraphs by startIndex+endIndex or textToFind. Use bulletPreset='NONE' to remove bullets.

textToFind.description: Text within the target paragraph(s) to bulletize

bulletPreset.description: Bullet style preset. Use NONE to remove bullets. Default: BULLET_DISC_CIRCLE_SQUARE

tools.name: findAndReplaceInDoc
tools.description: Find and replace text across a Google Document. Dry-run mode counts matches from paragraph text only (may differ from actual replacements which cover tables, headers, footers, etc.). For multi-tab docs, specify tabId to scope replacements to a single tab.

dryRun.description: Only count approximate matches from paragraph text, do not modify document (default: false). Ignores tabId — always scans the full document body.

tabId.description: Optional. Tab ID to scope replacements to (from listDocumentTabs). If omitted, replaces across all tabs.

tools.name: listComments
tools.description: List all comments in a Google Document

includeDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted comments (default: false)

pageToken.description: Token for next page of results

tools.name: getComment
tools.description: Get a specific comment with its full thread of replies

tools.name: addComment
tools.description: Add a comment anchored to a specific text range. Note: Due to Google API limitations, programmatic comments appear in 'All Comments' but may not be visibly anchored in the document UI.

tools.name: replyToComment
tools.description: Add a reply to an existing comment

commentId.description: The comment ID to reply to

resolve.description: Set to true to resolve the comment thread after replying (default: false)

tools.name: deleteComment
tools.description: Delete a comment from the document

tools.name: getGoogleDocContent
tools.description: Get content of a Google Doc with text indices for formatting

includeFormatting.description: Include font, style, and color info for each text span (default: false)

tools.name: insertTable
tools.description: Insert a new table with the specified dimensions at a given index

rows.description: Number of rows for the new table

columns.description: Number of columns for the new table

index.description: The index (1-based) where the table should be inserted

tools.name: editTableCell
tools.description: Edit the content and/or style of a specific table cell. Requires knowing the table start index.

tableStartIndex.description: The starting index of the TABLE element

textContent.description: New text content for the cell (replaces existing)

tools.name: insertImageFromUrl
tools.description: Insert an inline image into a Google Document from a publicly accessible URL

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL to the image

index.description: The index (1-based) where the image should be inserted

width.description: Width of the image in points

height.description: Height of the image in points

tools.name: insertLocalImage
tools.description: Upload a local image file to Google Drive and insert it into a Google Document

localImagePath.description: Absolute path to the local image file

index.description: The index (1-based) where the image should be inserted

width.description: Width of the image in points

height.description: Height of the image in points

uploadToSameFolder.description: Upload to same folder as document (default: true)

makePublic.description: Make uploaded image publicly accessible (anyone with the link can view). Set to true if the Docs API cannot access the image through the authenticated user's permissions. Default: false

tools.name: listGoogleDocs
tools.description: Lists Google Documents from your Google Drive with optional filtering.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of documents to return (1-100).

query.description: Search query to filter documents by name or content.

tools.name: getDocumentInfo
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a specific Google Document.

documentId.description: The ID of the Google Document (from the URL).

tools.name: addDocumentTab
tools.description: Add a new tab in a Google Doc

tools.name: renameDocumentTab
tools.description: Rename an existing Google Doc tab

tools.name: insertSmartChip
tools.description: Insert a person smart chip (mention) at a document index. Only person chips are supported by the Docs API; date and file chips are read-only.

personEmail.description: Email address for the person mention

tools.name: readSmartChips
tools.description: Read smart chip-like elements (person mentions, rich links, date chips) from the default tab of a document

tools.name: createFootnote
tools.description: Create a footnote in a Google Doc. Footnotes cannot be inserted inside equations, headers, footers, or other footnotes.

index.description: 1-based character index where the footnote reference should be inserted

endOfSegment.description: If true, insert footnote at the end of the document body (use instead of index)

content.description: Optional text content for the footnote body

tools.name: createGoogleSheet
tools.description: Create a new Google Sheet. By default uses RAW mode which stores values as-is. Set valueInputOption to 'USER_ENTERED' only when you need formulas to be evaluated.

valueInputOption.description: RAW (default): Values stored exactly as provided - formulas stored as text strings. Safe for untrusted data. USER_ENTERED: Values parsed like spreadsheet UI - formulas (=SUM, =IF, etc.) are evaluated. SECURITY WARNING: USER_ENTERED can execute formulas, only use with trusted data, never with user-provided input that could contain malicious formulas like =IMPORTDATA() or =IMPORTRANGE().

tools.name: updateGoogleSheet
tools.description: Update an existing Google Sheet. By default uses RAW mode which stores values as-is. Set valueInputOption to 'USER_ENTERED' only when you need formulas to be evaluated.

valueInputOption.description: RAW (default): Values stored exactly as provided - formulas stored as text strings. Safe for untrusted data. USER_ENTERED: Values parsed like spreadsheet UI - formulas (=SUM, =IF, etc.) are evaluated. SECURITY WARNING: USER_ENTERED can execute formulas, only use with trusted data, never with user-provided input that could contain malicious formulas like =IMPORTDATA() or =IMPORTRANGE().

tools.name: getGoogleSheetContent
tools.description: Get content of a Google Sheet with cell information

tools.name: formatGoogleSheetCells
tools.description: Format cells in a Google Sheet (background, borders, alignment)

tools.name: formatGoogleSheetText
tools.description: Apply text formatting to cells in a Google Sheet

tools.name: formatGoogleSheetNumbers
tools.description: Apply number formatting to cells in a Google Sheet

tools.name: setGoogleSheetBorders
tools.description: Set borders for cells in a Google Sheet

tools.name: mergeGoogleSheetCells
tools.description: Merge cells in a Google Sheet

tools.name: addGoogleSheetConditionalFormat
tools.description: Add conditional formatting to a Google Sheet

format.description: Format to apply when condition is true

tools.name: getSpreadsheetInfo
tools.description: Gets detailed information about a Google Spreadsheet including all sheets/tabs

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the Google Spreadsheet (from the URL)

tools.name: appendSpreadsheetRows
tools.description: Appends rows of data to the end of a sheet in a Google Spreadsheet

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the Google Spreadsheet (from the URL)

range.description: A1 notation range indicating where to append (e.g., 'A1' or 'Sheet1!A1'). Data will be appended starting from this range.

values.description: 2D array of values to append. Each inner array represents a row.

valueInputOption.description: How input data should be interpreted (RAW or USER_ENTERED)

tools.name: addSpreadsheetSheet
tools.description: Adds a new sheet/tab to an existing Google Spreadsheet

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the Google Spreadsheet (from the URL)

tools.name: addSheet
tools.description: Alias for addSpreadsheetSheet (adds a new sheet/tab)

tools.name: listSheets
tools.description: List tabs/sheets in a Google Spreadsheet

tools.name: renameSheet
tools.description: Rename a sheet/tab by sheetId

tools.name: deleteSheet
tools.description: Delete a sheet/tab by sheetId

tools.name: addDataValidation
tools.description: Add data validation rules to a sheet range

tools.name: protectRange
tools.description: Protect a range in a spreadsheet

tools.name: addNamedRange
tools.description: Create a named range

tools.name: listGoogleSheets
tools.description: Lists Google Spreadsheets from your Google Drive with optional filtering

maxResults.description: Maximum number of spreadsheets to return (1-100)

query.description: Search query to filter spreadsheets by name or content

tools.name: createGoogleSlides
tools.description: Create a new Google Slides presentation

tools.name: updateGoogleSlides
tools.description: Update an existing Google Slides presentation

slides.description: Array of slide objects to replace existing slides

tools.name: getGoogleSlidesContent
tools.description: Get content of Google Slides with element IDs for formatting

tools.name: formatGoogleSlidesText
tools.description: Apply text formatting to elements in Google Slides

objectId.description: Object ID of the text element

tools.name: formatGoogleSlidesParagraph
tools.description: Apply paragraph formatting to text in Google Slides

objectId.description: Object ID of the text element

tools.name: styleGoogleSlidesShape
tools.description: Style shapes in Google Slides

tools.name: setGoogleSlidesBackground
tools.description: Set background color for slides

pageObjectIds.description: Array of slide IDs to update

tools.name: createGoogleSlidesTextBox
tools.description: Create a text box in Google Slides

tools.name: createGoogleSlidesShape
tools.description: Create a shape in Google Slides

tools.name: getGoogleSlidesSpeakerNotes
tools.description: Get speaker notes from a specific slide in Google Slides

tools.name: updateGoogleSlidesSpeakerNotes
tools.description: Update speaker notes for a specific slide in Google Slides

tools.name: deleteGoogleSlide
tools.description: Delete a slide from a presentation

tools.name: duplicateSlide
tools.description: Duplicate a slide in a presentation

tools.name: reorderSlides
tools.description: Reorder one or more slides in a presentation

tools.name: replaceAllTextInSlides
tools.description: Replace all matching text across presentation slides

tools.name: exportSlideThumbnail
tools.description: Export a slide thumbnail URL

tools.name: insertSlidesImageFromUrl
tools.description: Insert an image into a Google Slides slide from a publicly accessible URL

pageObjectId.description: Slide/page object ID to insert the image into

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible URL of the image

tools.name: getSlideElementInfo
tools.description: Get position, size, and transform of all elements on a slide. Returns actual rendered bounds.

slideObjectId.description: Slide object ID (omit to get all slides)

tools.name: moveSlideElement
tools.description: Move and/or resize an element (image, text box, shape) on a Google Slides slide

tools.name: deleteSlideElement
tools.description: Delete an element (image, text box, shape) from a Google Slides slide

tools.name: insertSlidesLocalImage
tools.description: Upload a local image file to Google Drive and insert it into a Google Slides slide

pageObjectId.description: Slide/page object ID to insert the image into

localImagePath.description: Absolute path to the local image file

tools.name: listCalendars
tools.description: List all accessible Google Calendars for the authenticated user

tools.name: getCalendarEvents
tools.description: Get events from a Google Calendar with optional filtering

singleEvents.description: Expand recurring events into instances (default: true)

tools.name: getCalendarEvent
tools.description: Get a single calendar event by ID

tools.name: createCalendarEvent
tools.description: Create a new calendar event. Supports timed events, all-day events, and Google Meet integration.

start.description: Start time (use dateTime for timed events, date for all-day)

tools.name: updateCalendarEvent
tools.description: Update an existing calendar event

tools.name: deleteCalendarEvent
tools.description: Delete a calendar event
